Check which optional libraries chebpol was built with

Source: R/libraries.R
has_fftw.Rd

chebpol can be compiled with or without three optional C libraries, each of which enables part of the package:

Usage

has_fftw()

has_alglib()

has_gsl()

Value

TRUE if chebpol was built with the library, otherwise FALSE.

Details

  • FFTW computes Chebyshev coefficients with a fast DCT. Without it, chebcoef() and ipol() with method = "chebyshev" use a matrix product, which is not feasible for high-degree polynomials: a 100x100x100 approximation is possible, but not a one-dimensional 1000000.

  • ALGLIB provides compact support radial basis function interpolation of scattered data, ipol() with method = "crbf".

  • GSL solves for the degree of the stalker splines on a non-uniform grid. Without it, ipol() with method = "stalker" uses degree 2 there and warns, and method = "oldstalker" with k = NA stops with an error.

Examples

has_fftw()
#> [1] TRUE
has_alglib()
#> [1] FALSE
has_gsl()
#> [1] TRUE
